english_text: Health education is a lifelong journey of learning and growth.
sesotho_text: Thuto ea bophelo bo botle ke leeto la bophelo bohle la ho ithuta le ho hola.

english_text: Using a condom correctly every time you have sex prevents HIV and STIs.
sesotho_text: Ho sebelisa condom ka nepo nako le nako ha o kopana ka thobalano ho thibela HIV le li-STI.

english_text: Condoms are available free of charge at all public health clinics.
sesotho_text: Li-condom li fumaneha mahala likiliniking tsohle tsa bophelo bo botle tsa sechaba.

english_text: Both male and female condoms are available at the clinic.
sesotho_text: Li-condom tsa banna le tsa basali li fumaneha klinikeng.

english_text: Use a new condom every time you have sexual intercourse.
sesotho_text: Sebelisa condom e ncha nako le nako ha o kopana ka thobalano.

english_text: Check the expiry date on the condom before using it.
sesotho_text: Hlahloba letsatsi la ho fela la condom pele ho e sebelisa.

english_text: Do not use oil-based lubricants with latex condoms.
sesotho_text: O se ke oa sebelisa li-lubricant tse thehiloeng ho oli le li-condom tsa latex.

english_text: Water-based lubricants are safe to use with condoms.
sesotho_text: Li-lubricant tse thehiloeng ho metsi li bolokehile ho sebelisa le li-condom.

english_text: PrEP is a medication that prevents HIV in HIV-negative people.
sesotho_text: PrEP ke moriana o thibelang HIV ho batho ba sa nang HIV.

english_text: Ask your clinic about PrEP if you are at high risk of HIV.
sesotho_text: Botsa kliniki ea hao ka PrEP haeba o le kotsing e phahameng ea HIV.

english_text: PEP is an emergency medication taken after possible HIV exposure.
sesotho_text: PEP ke moriana oa tšohanyetso o nkoang ka mor'a ho ka amoa HIV.

english_text: PEP must be started within seventy-two hours of exposure.
sesotho_text: PEP e tlameha ho qalisoa ka hare ho lihora tse mashome a supileng le metso e mebeli ea ho amoa.

english_text: PEP must be taken for twenty-eight days without missing doses.
sesotho_text: PEP e tlameha ho nkoa matsatsi a mashome a mabeli le metso e robeli ntle le ho lahlehela li-dose.

english_text: Seek medical attention immediately after a possible HIV exposure.
sesotho_text: Batla tlhokomelo ea bongaka hang hang ka mor'a ho ka amoa HIV.

english_text: Get tested for HIV and STIs regularly if you are sexually active.
sesotho_text: Hlahlojoa bakeng sa HIV le li-STI ka mehla haeba o kopana ka thobalano.

english_text: Knowing your HIV status protects you and your partner.
sesotho_text: Ho tseba boemo ba hao ba HIV bo sireletsa uena le molekane oa hao.

english_text: Encourage your partner to get tested for HIV together.
sesotho_text: Khothaletsa molekane oa hao ho hlahlojoa bakeng sa HIV hammoho.

english_text: Disclosure of your HIV status to your partner is important.
sesotho_text: Ho tsebisa molekane oa hao boemo ba hao ba HIV ho bohlokoa.

english_text: Support is available for people who need help with disclosure.
sesotho_text: Tshehetso e fumaneha ho batho ba hlokang thuso ka ho tsebisa.

english_text: Sexually transmitted infections increase the risk of HIV transmission.
sesotho_text: Tšoaetso tse fetisanang ka thobalano li eketsa kotsi ea ho fetisela HIV.

english_text: Treat all sexually transmitted infections promptly and completely.
sesotho_text: Alafa tšoaetso tsohle tse fetisanang ka thobalano kapele le ka botlalo.

english_text: Symptoms of STIs include discharge, sores, burning, and pain.
sesotho_text: Matšoao a li-STI a kenyelletsa seretse, maqeba, ho chesa, le mahloko.

english_text: Some STIs have no symptoms and can only be detected by testing.
sesotho_text: Li-STI tse ling ha li na matšoao mme li ka fumanoa feela ka tlhahlobo.

english_text: Regular STI testing is recommended for sexually active people.
sesotho_text: Ho hlahlojoa bakeng sa li-STI ka mehla ho khothaletsoa bakeng sa batho ba kopanang ka thobalano.

english_text: Inform your sexual partner if you are diagnosed with an STI.
sesotho_text: Tsebisa molekane oa hao oa thobalano haeba o hlahlojoe ka STI.

english_text: Both partners must be treated for an STI at the same time.
sesotho_text: Baratwi ba babeli ba tlameha ho alafioa bakeng sa STI ka nako e tšoanang.

english_text: Avoid sexual contact until both partners have completed STI treatment.
sesotho_text: Hana ho kopana ka thobalano ho fihlela baratwi ba babeli ba phetela phekolo ea STI.

english_text: Reducing the number of sexual partners reduces the risk of STIs.
sesotho_text: Ho fokotsa palo ea baratwi ba thobalano ho fokotsa kotsi ea li-STI.

english_text: Mutual faithfulness between tested partners reduces HIV risk.
sesotho_text: Botsepeli bo tšoanang lipakeng tsa baratwi ba hlahlojotsoeng bo fokotsa kotsi ea HIV.

english_text: Alcohol and drug use increase the risk of unsafe sexual behaviour.
sesotho_text: Ho sebelisa joala le lithethefatsi ho eketsa kotsi ea boitšoaro ba thobalano bo sa bolokehang.

english_text: Avoid making sexual decisions when under the influence of alcohol.
sesotho_text: Hana ho etsa liqeto tsa thobalano ha o tlasa tšusumetso ea joala.

english_text: Sexual violence increases the risk of HIV and STI transmission.
sesotho_text: Tlhekefetso ea thobalano e eketsa kotsi ea ho fetisela HIV le li-STI.

english_text: Seek medical care immediately after sexual violence.
sesotho_text: Batla tlhokomelo ea bongaka hang hang ka mor'a tlhekefetso ea thobalano.

english_text: Post-exposure prophylaxis is available after sexual violence.
sesotho_text: Phekolo ea thibelo ka mor'a ho amoa e fumaneha ka mor'a tlhekefetso ea thobalano.

english_text: Report sexual violence to the police and seek legal support.
sesotho_text: Bua ka tlhekefetso ea thobalano mapoliseng mme u batle tshehetso ea molao.

english_text: Support is available for survivors of sexual violence.
sesotho_text: Tshehetso e fumaneha bakeng sa ba pholositsoeng ho tlhekefetso ea thobalano.

english_text: Cervical cancer is caused by the human papillomavirus.
sesotho_text: Kankere ea molala oa mphe e bakoa ke human papillomavirus.

english_text: The HPV vaccine protects against cervical cancer.
sesotho_text: Ente ea HPV e sireletsa ho kankere ea molala oa mphe.

english_text: Girls should receive the HPV vaccine before becoming sexually active.
sesotho_text: Banana ba lokela ho amohela ente ea HPV pele ba qala ho kopana ka thobalano.

english_text: Regular cervical screening detects abnormal cells before they become cancer.
sesotho_text: Ho hlahloba molala oa mphe ka mehla ho fumana lisele tse sa tloaelehang pele li fetoha kankere.

english_text: Women should have a cervical smear test every three years.
sesotho_text: Basali ba lokela ho ba le tlhahlobo ea molala oa mphe lilomong tse tharo le 'ngoe le e 'ngoe.

english_text: Hepatitis B is transmitted through sexual contact and blood.
sesotho_text: Hepatitis B e fetisoa ka ho kopana ka thobalano le mali.

english_text: Vaccination against hepatitis B protects your liver.
sesotho_text: Ho entisoa bakeng sa hepatitis B ho sireletsa sebete sa hao.

english_text: Herpes is a lifelong viral infection that can be managed with medication.
sesotho_text: Herpes ke tšoaetso ea vaerase ea bophelo bohle e ka laoloang ka moriana.

english_text: Gonorrhoea and chlamydia are bacterial infections that are treatable.
sesotho_text: Gonorrhoea le chlamydia ke tšoaetso tsa baekteria tse ka alafoang.

english_text: Syphilis is a serious STI that can be cured with antibiotics.
sesotho_text: Syphilis ke STI e matla e ka folisioang ka li-antibiotic.

english_text: Untreated syphilis can cause serious damage to the heart and brain.
sesotho_text: Syphilis e sa alafoang e ka baka kotsi e matla ho pelo le boko.

english_text: Trichomoniasis is a common STI that is easily treated.
sesotho_text: Trichomoniasis ke STI e tloaelehileng e alafoang habonolo.

english_text: All STIs are treatable and most are curable with the right medication.
sesotho_text: Li-STI tsohle li ka alafioa mme tse ngata li ka folisoa ka moriana o nepahetseng.

english_text: Do not be ashamed to seek treatment for a sexually transmitted infection.
sesotho_text: O se ke oa hlajoa ke maswabi ho batla phekolo bakeng sa tšoaetso e fetisanang ka thobalano.

english_text: Healthcare workers treat all STI patients with confidentiality and respect.
sesotho_text: Basebetsi ba tlhokomelo ea bophelo bo botle ba phethela bakuloi bohle ba li-STI ka sephiri le hlompho.

english_text: Sexual health is an important part of your overall health and wellbeing.
sesotho_text: Bophelo ba thobalano ke karolo ea bohlokoa ea bophelo ba hao ka bophara le boiketlo.

english_text: Open communication with your partner about sexual health is important.
sesotho_text: Ho buisana ka bolokolohi le molekane oa hao ka bophelo ba thobalano ho bohlokoa.

english_text: Healthy relationships are built on trust, respect, and communication.
sesotho_text: Likamano tse ntle li thehiloe ho tšepo, hlompho, le puisano.

english_text: Gender-based violence is a public health issue that requires urgent action.
sesotho_text: Tlhekefetso e thehiloeng ho bong ke bothata ba bophelo ba sechaba bo hlokang ketso ea potlako.

english_text: Seek help if you are experiencing violence in your relationship.
sesotho_text: Batla thuso haeba o ikutloa tlhekefetso kamanong ea hao.

english_text: Support services for gender-based violence are available at the clinic.
sesotho_text: Litšebeletso tsa tshehetso bakeng sa tlhekefetso e thehiloeng ho bong li fumaneha klinikeng.

english_text: Every person deserves to be in a safe and healthy relationship.
sesotho_text: Motho e mong le e mong o lokeloa ke ho ba kamanong e bolokehileng le e phela hantle.

english_text: Your sexual health decisions affect your long-term health and wellbeing.
sesotho_text: Liqeto tsa hao tsa bophelo ba thobalano li angoa bophelo ba hao ba nako e telele le boiketlo.

english_text: Mental health is a state of wellbeing in which you can cope with daily life.
sesotho_text: Bophelo ba kelello ke boemo ba boiketlo moo o khonang ho sebetsana le bophelo ba letsatsi le leng le le leng.

english_text: One in four people will experience a mental health problem in their lifetime.
sesotho_text: Motho e mong ho batho ba bane o tla ikutloa bothata ba bophelo ba kelello bophelong ba hae.

english_text: Mental health problems are common and nothing to be ashamed of.
sesotho_text: Mathata a bophelo ba kelello a tloaelehile mme ha ho letho la ho hlajoa ke maswabi.

english_text: Depression is more than just feeling sad — it is a medical condition.
sesotho_text: Khutsanyetso e feta ho ikutloa o masoabi feela — ke boemo ba bongaka.

english_text: Symptoms of depression include persistent sadness, loss of interest, and fatigue.
sesotho_text: Matšoao a khutsanyetso a kenyelletsa masoabi a tsoelang pele, ho lahleheloa ke khahliso, le ho lapala.

english_text: Anxiety is a feeling of excessive worry and fear that affects daily life.
sesotho_text: Ho tšoha ke maikutlo a ho khathallela le ho tšaba ho feteletseng a angoa bophelo ba letsatsi le leng le le leng.

english_text: Symptoms of anxiety include restlessness, racing heart, and difficulty sleeping.
sesotho_text: Matšoao a ho tšoha a kenyelletsa ho se khutse, pelo e otlang ka potlako, le bothata ba ho robala.

english_text: Post-traumatic stress disorder can develop after a traumatic event.
sesotho_text: Maemo a khatello ea maikutlo ka mor'a kotsi a ka hlaha ka mor'a tikoloho e bohloko.

english_text: Schizophrenia is a serious mental illness that affects thinking and behaviour.
sesotho_text: Schizophrenia ke bolwetse ba kelello bo bobe bo angoa ho nahana le boitšoaro.

english_text: Bipolar disorder causes extreme mood swings between highs and lows.
sesotho_text: Bipolar disorder e baka ho fetohafetohoa ha maikutlo ho tloha ho phahama ho ea tlase.

english_text: Mental health conditions are caused by a combination of factors.
sesotho_text: Maemo a bophelo ba kelello a bakoa ke kopano ea lintlha tse fapaneng.

english_text: Stress, trauma, genetics, and substance abuse can affect mental health.
sesotho_text: Khatello ea maikutlo, kotsi, bo-ralikhele, le ho sebelisa litšebelisoa ka ho feteletseng li ka angoa bophelo ba kelello.

english_text: Mental health problems can affect anyone regardless of age or background.
sesotho_text: Mathata a bophelo ba kelello a ka angoa motho e mong le e mong ntle le ho sheba lilomo kapa morao.

english_text: Children and adolescents can also experience mental health problems.
sesotho_text: Bana le bacha le bona ba ka ikutloa mathata a bophelo ba kelello.

english_text: Older adults are at increased risk of depression and cognitive decline.
sesotho_text: Batho ba baholo ba le kotsing e eketsehileng ea khutsanyetso le ho fokotsehela ha kelello.

english_text: People living with chronic illness are at higher risk of depression.
sesotho_text: Batho ba phelang le mahlwetse a tsoelang pele ba le kotsing e phahameng ea khutsanyetso.

english_text: Substance abuse and mental health problems often occur together.
sesotho_text: Ho sebelisa litšebelisoa ka ho feteletseng le mathata a bophelo ba kelello hangata a etsahala hammoho.

english_text: Seek help early if you notice changes in your mood or behaviour.
sesotho_text: Batla thuso kapele haeba o hona liphetoho maikutlong kapa boitšoarong ba hao.

english_text: Talk to your doctor or nurse if you are struggling with your mental health.
sesotho_text: Bua le ngaka ea hao kapa mooki haeba o na le bothata ba bophelo ba hao ba kelello.

english_text: Mental health treatment includes counselling, medication, and support groups.
sesotho_text: Phekolo ea bophelo ba kelello e kenyelletsa keletso, moriana, le lisehlopha tsa tshehetso.

english_text: Counselling helps you understand and manage your thoughts and feelings.
sesotho_text: Keletso e thusa ho utloisisa le ho laola menahano le maikutlo a hao.

english_text: Cognitive behavioural therapy is an effective treatment for depression and anxiety.
sesotho_text: Phekolo ea boitšoaro ba kelello ke phekolo e sebetsang bakeng sa khutsanyetso le ho tšoha.

english_text: Medication can help correct chemical imbalances in the brain.
sesotho_text: Moriana o ka thusa ho balelisa ho se lekalekane ha likhemikale bokong.

english_text: Take your mental health medication every day as prescribed.
sesotho_text: Nka moriana oa bophelo ba kelello letsatsi le leng le le leng joalo ka ha ho laetsoe.

english_text: Do not stop your mental health medication without consulting your doctor.
sesotho_text: O se ke oa emisa moriana oa bophelo ba kelello ntle le ho buisana le ngaka ea hao.

english_text: Recovery from mental illness is possible with the right treatment and support.
sesotho_text: Ho fola ho tsoa bolwetseng ba kelello ho khonehile ka phekolo e nepahetseng le tshehetso.

english_text: Support from family and friends is vital for mental health recovery.
sesotho_text: Tshehetso ho tsoa lelapeng le metsoalleng e bohlokoa haholo bakeng sa ho fola ha bophelo ba kelello.

english_text: Reduce stigma by treating people with mental illness with respect.
sesotho_text: Fokotsa koluoa ka ho phethela batho ba nang le bolwetse ba kelello ka hlompho.

english_text: Do not use hurtful language when talking about mental health.
sesotho_text: O se ke oa sebelisa puo e bohloko ha o bua ka bophelo ba kelello.

english_text: Educate yourself and others about mental health conditions.
sesotho_text: Ithuta le ho ruta ba bang ka maemo a bophelo ba kelello.

english_text: Self-care is an important part of maintaining good mental health.
sesotho_text: Ho itlhokomela ke karolo ea bohlokoa ea ho boloka bophelo bo botle ba kelello.

english_text: Practice relaxation techniques such as deep breathing and meditation.
sesotho_text: Itlwaetse mekhoa ea ho khutsa joalo ka ho hema ka botebo le ho nahanisisa.

english_text: Spend time in nature to improve your mood and reduce stress.
sesotho_text: Sebelisa nako tlholehing ho ntlafatsa maikutlo a hao le ho fokotsa khatello ea maikutlo.

english_text: Physical activity is one of the most effective ways to improve mental health.
sesotho_text: Mesebetsi ea 'mele ke e le ngoe ea mekhoa e sebetsang ka ho fetisisa ea ho ntlafatsa bophelo ba kelello.

english_text: Maintain social connections to protect your mental health.
sesotho_text: Boloka likopano tsa sechaba ho sireletsa bophelo ba hao ba kelello.

english_text: Limit alcohol and drug use to protect your mental health.
sesotho_text: Fokotsa ho sebelisa joala le lithethefatsi ho sireletsa bophelo ba hao ba kelello.

english_text: Set realistic goals and celebrate small achievements.
sesotho_text: Beha maano a khonehang mme u keteke liphetho tse nyenyane.

english_text: Be kind to yourself and avoid negative self-talk.
sesotho_text: Ba molemo ho uena mme u hane ho itšohla.

english_text: Seek help if you are having thoughts of harming yourself.
sesotho_text: Batla thuso haeba o na le menahano ea ho itšenya.

english_text: Suicide is preventable with the right support and intervention.
sesotho_text: Ho itsebetsa ho ka thibeloa ka tshehetso e nepahetseng le ho kenella.

english_text: Crisis support lines are available if you need immediate help.
sesotho_text: Mehala ea tshehetso ea crisis e fumaneha haeba o hloka thuso ea potlako.

english_text: You are not alone — help is available and recovery is possible.
sesotho_text: Ha o le mong — thuso e fumaneha mme ho fola ho khonehile.

english_text: Mental health awareness reduces stigma and encourages help-seeking.
sesotho_text: Temoso ea bophelo ba kelello e fokotsa koluoa le ho khothaletsa ho batla thuso.

english_text: Workplaces should support employees with mental health problems.
sesotho_text: Libaka tsa mosebetsi li lokela ho tshehetsa basebetsi ba nang le mathata a bophelo ba kelello.

english_text: Schools should provide mental health support for learners.
sesotho_text: Likolo li lokela ho fana ka tshehetso ea bophelo ba kelello bakeng sa baithuti.

english_text: Communities play an important role in supporting mental health.
sesotho_text: Sechaba se bapala karolo ea bohlokoa ho tshehetsa bophelo ba kelello.

english_text: Traditional healers and faith leaders can complement mental health care.
sesotho_text: Lingaka tsa setso le baetapele ba tumelo ba ka tlatsa tlhokomelo ea bophelo ba kelello.

english_text: Integrate mental health care into your overall healthcare routine.
sesotho_text: Kenyelletsa tlhokomelo ea bophelo ba kelello mekhoaneng ea hao yohle ea tlhokomelo ea bophelo bo botle.

english_text: Mental health and physical health are closely connected.
sesotho_text: Bophelo ba kelello le bophelo ba 'mele li amanane haufi.

english_text: Addressing mental health improves outcomes for all chronic conditions.
sesotho_text: Ho sebetsana le bophelo ba kelello ho ntlafatsa liphetho bakeng sa maemo ohle a tsoelang pele.

english_text: Invest in your mental health as you would invest in your physical health.
sesotho_text: Beha chelete bophelong ba hao ba kelello joalo ka ha o beha chelete bophelong ba hao ba 'mele.

english_text: A mentally healthy community is a productive and thriving community.
sesotho_text: Sechaba se phela hantle ka kelello ke sechaba se sebetsang le se holang.

english_text: Speak up about mental health and help break the silence.
sesotho_text: Bua ka bophelo ba kelello mme u thuse ho qoba khutsiso.

english_text: Your mental health matters and you deserve support and care.
sesotho_text: Bophelo ba hao ba kelello bo bohlokoa mme o lokeloa ke tshehetso le tlhokomelo.

english_text: Reaching out for help is a sign of strength not weakness.
sesotho_text: Ho batla thuso ke sesupo sa matla e seng ho fokotsehela.

english_text: Every step towards better mental health is worth celebrating.
sesotho_text: Mohato o mong le o mong o eang ho bophelo bo botle ba kelello o lokeloa ke ho ketekoa.

english_text: You have the power to improve your mental health one day at a time.
sesotho_text: O na le matla a ho ntlafatsa bophelo ba hao ba kelello letsatsi le le leng ka nako.

english_text: Mental health is a journey and every journey begins with a single step.
sesotho_text: Bophelo ba kelello ke leeto mme leeto le leng le le leng le qala ka mohato o le mong.

english_text: Together we can build a world where mental health is valued and protected.
sesotho_text: Hammoho re ka haha lefatše moo bophelo ba kelello bo hlomphuoa le ho sireleltsoa.

english_text: Community health workers are trained to provide basic health services.
sesotho_text: Basebetsi ba bophelo ba sechaba ba rutiloe ho fana ka litšebeletso tsa motheo tsa bophelo bo botle.

english_text: Community health workers can visit you at home for health support.
sesotho_text: Basebetsi ba bophelo ba sechaba ba ka etela lapeng bakeng sa tshehetso ea bophelo bo botle.

english_text: Ask your community health worker about health services in your area.
sesotho_text: Botsa mosebetsi oa hao oa bophelo ba sechaba ka litšebeletso tsa bophelo bo botle sebakeng sa hao.

english_text: Community health campaigns provide free testing and treatment.
sesotho_text: Likhampheini tsa bophelo ba sechaba li fana ka tlhahlobo le phekolo mahala.

english_text: Attend community health days to access free health services.
sesotho_text: Tla matsatsing a bophelo ba sechaba ho fihlela litšebeletso tsa bophelo bo botle mahala.

english_text: Health promotion activities educate communities about disease prevention.
sesotho_text: Mesebetsi ea ho khothaletsa bophelo bo botle e ruta sechaba ka ho thibela mahlwetse.

english_text: School health programmes provide health education and services to learners.
sesotho_text: Mananeo a bophelo bo botle a likolo a fana ka thuto ea bophelo le litšebeletso ho baithuti.

english_text: Workplace wellness programmes support the health of employees.
sesotho_text: Mananeo a boiketlo ba sebaka sa mosebetsi a tshehetsa bophelo ba basebetsi.

english_text: Faith communities play an important role in health promotion.
sesotho_text: Sechaba sa tumelo se bapala karolo ea bohlokoa ho khothaletseng bophelo bo botle.

english_text: Traditional leaders can support health campaigns in their communities.
sesotho_text: Baetapele ba setso ba ka tshehetsa likhampheini tsa bophelo bo botle sechababeng sa bona.

english_text: Community gardens improve food security and nutrition.
sesotho_text: Lipolase tsa sechaba li ntlafatsa ts'ireletso ea lijo le phepo.

english_text: Clean water and sanitation are essential for community health.
sesotho_text: Metsi a hloekileng le bohloekileng ke tsa bohlokoa bakeng sa bophelo ba sechaba.

english_text: Advocate for clean water and proper sanitation in your community.
sesotho_text: Lwela metsi a hloekileng le bohloekileng bo nepahetseng sechababeng sa hao.

english_text: Environmental health affects the health of the entire community.
sesotho_text: Bophelo ba tikoloho bo angoa bophelo ba sechaba ka bophara.

english_text: Report environmental health hazards to the local authorities.
sesotho_text: Bua ka likotsi tsa bophelo ba tikoloho ho ba ba nang le matla ba sebaka.

english_text: Air pollution increases the risk of respiratory diseases.
sesotho_text: Tšilafalo ea moea e eketsa kotsi ea mahlwetse a ho hema.

english_text: Reduce indoor air pollution by improving ventilation in your home.
sesotho_text: Fokotsa tšilafalo ea moea ka hare ho ntlo ka ho ntlafatsa phallo ea moea ntlong ea hao.

english_text: Avoid burning waste near homes and communities.
sesotho_text: Hana ho chesa molapo haufi le matlo le sechaba.

english_text: Safe roads and public spaces reduce the risk of injuries.
sesotho_text: Litsela tse bolokehileng le libaka tsa sechaba li fokotsa kotsi ea likotsi.

english_text: Road traffic accidents are a major cause of death and disability.
sesotho_text: Likotsi tsa sephethephethe tsa tsela ke sesosa se seholo sa lefu le bokooa.

english_text: Wear a seatbelt every time you travel in a vehicle.
sesotho_text: Apara seatbelt nako le nako ha o tsamaea koloing.

english_text: Do not use your phone while driving.
sesotho_text: O se ke oa sebelisa mohala oa hao ha o khanna.

english_text: Never drink and drive.
sesotho_text: O se ke oa noa mme u khanne.

english_text: Pedestrians should use designated crossings and walkways.
sesotho_text: Baeti ba maoto ba lokela ho sebelisa libaka tse khethiloeng tsa ho tšela le ho tsamaea.

english_text: Cyclists should wear helmets and use designated lanes.
sesotho_text: Bapalami ba baesekele ba lokela ho apara lihelmet le ho sebelisa litsela tse khethiloeng.

english_text: Drowning prevention requires supervision near water at all times.
sesotho_text: Ho thibela ho fifela ho hloka ho lebelloa haufi le metsi nako tsohle.

english_text: Teach children to swim to reduce the risk of drowning.
sesotho_text: Ruta bana ho nea ho fokotsa kotsi ea ho fifela.

english_text: Fire safety education prevents burns and fire-related deaths.
sesotho_text: Thuto ea polokeho ea mollo e thibela ho chesa le lifu tse amanang le mollo.

english_text: Install smoke detectors in your home.
sesotho_text: Kenya li-smoke detector ntlong ea hao.

english_text: Keep a first aid kit at home and know how to use it.
sesotho_text: Boloka sete ea thuso ea pele lapeng mme u tsebe ho e sebelisa.

english_text: Learn basic first aid skills to help in an emergency.
sesotho_text: Ithuta bokgoni ba motheo ba thuso ea pele ho thusa nakong ea tšohanyetso.

english_text: Know how to perform cardiopulmonary resuscitation.
sesotho_text: Tseba ho etsa cardiopulmonary resuscitation.

english_text: Call for emergency help immediately in a life-threatening situation.
sesotho_text: Letsetsa thuso ea tšohanyetso hang hang boemong ba kotsi ea bophelo.

english_text: Do not move an injured person unless they are in immediate danger.
sesotho_text: O se ke oa tsamaisa motho ea hlolofalitseng ntle le haeba a le kotsing ea potlako.

english_text: Occupational health protects workers from work-related illnesses.
sesotho_text: Bophelo ba mosebetsi bo sireletsa basebetsi ho mahlwetse a amanang le mosebetsi.

english_text: Wear personal protective equipment in hazardous work environments.
sesotho_text: Apara liaparo tsa tšireletso ea botho libakeng tsa mosebetsi tse kotsi.

english_text: Report work-related injuries and illnesses to your employer.
sesotho_text: Bua ka likotsi le mahlwetse a amanang le mosebetsi ho mong'a mosebetsi oa hao.

english_text: Ergonomics reduces the risk of musculoskeletal injuries at work.
sesotho_text: Ergonomics e fokotsa kotsi ea likotsi tsa mochine le marapo mosebetsing.

english_text: Take regular breaks to prevent fatigue and injury at work.
sesotho_text: Nka maphomelo a kamehla ho thibela ho lapala le likotsi mosebetsing.

english_text: Ageing is a natural process that requires ongoing health management.
sesotho_text: Ho hola ke ts'ebetso ea tlhaho e hlokang taolo ea bophelo e tsoelang pele.

english_text: Older adults should have regular health check-ups.
sesotho_text: Batho ba baholo ba lokela ho ba le litlhahlobo tsa bophelo tsa kamehla.

english_text: Falls are a leading cause of injury in older adults.
sesotho_text: Ho wa ke sesosa se seholo sa likotsi ho batho ba baholo.

english_text: Remove hazards in the home to prevent falls in older adults.
sesotho_text: Ntša likotsi ntlong ho thibela ho wa ha batho ba baholo.

english_text: Social isolation increases the risk of depression in older adults.
sesotho_text: Ho arohanngoa sechababeng ho eketsa kotsi ea khutsanyetso ho batho ba baholo.

english_text: Encourage older adults to stay socially active and engaged.
sesotho_text: Khothaletsa batho ba baholo ho lula ba sebetsa le ho kenella sechababeng.

english_text: Dementia is a condition that affects memory and daily functioning.
sesotho_text: Dementia ke boemo bo angoa kelello ea ho hopola le tšebetso ea letsatsi le leng le le leng.

english_text: Early diagnosis of dementia allows for better planning and support.
sesotho_text: Ho hlahlojoa ha dementia kapele ho lumela ho rererela le ho tshehetsa hantle.

english_text: Caregivers of people with dementia also need support and rest.
sesotho_text: Bahlokeli ba batho ba nang le dementia le bona ba hloka tshehetso le ho khutsa.

english_text: Palliative care improves the quality of life for people with serious illness.
sesotho_text: Tlhokomelo ea ho fokotsa bohloko e ntlafatsa boleng ba bophelo bakeng sa batho ba nang le mahlwetse a matla.

english_text: Hospice care provides comfort and dignity at the end of life.
sesotho_text: Tlhokomelo ea hospice e fana ka khutso le tlotlo qetellong ea bophelo.

english_text: Advance care planning allows you to express your wishes for end-of-life care.
sesotho_text: Ho rererela tlhokomelo pele ho lumela ho bua litaelo tsa hao tsa tlhokomelo qetellong ea bophelo.

english_text: Grief and bereavement support is available after the loss of a loved one.
sesotho_text: Tshehetso ea masoabi le ho lahleheloa e fumaneha ka mor'a ho lahleheloa ke motho ea ratoang.

english_text: Health literacy empowers communities to make informed health decisions.
sesotho_text: Ho tseba ho bala le ho ngola ka bophelo bo botle ho matlafatsa sechaba ho etsa liqeto tse tsebisitsoeng tsa bophelo.

english_text: Access to health information is a right for all community members.
sesotho_text: Ho fihlela tlhahisoleseling ea bophelo bo botle ke tokelo ea maloko ohle a sechaba.

english_text: Digital health tools can help you manage your health more effectively.
sesotho_text: Lisebelisoa tsa dijithale tsa bophelo bo botle li ka thusa ho laola bophelo ba hao ka nepo e eketsehileng.

english_text: Use reliable sources of health information such as the clinic and health department.
sesotho_text: Sebelisa mehloli e tšepahalang ea tlhahisoleseling ea bophelo joalo ka kliniki le lefapha la bophelo bo botle.

english_text: Avoid spreading unverified health information on social media.
sesotho_text: Hana ho atatisa tlhahisoleseling ea bophelo e sa netefatsoang marang-rangeng a sechaba.

english_text: Verify health information with a qualified healthcare professional.
sesotho_text: Netefatsa tlhahisoleseling ea bophelo le setsebi se hlophisitsoeng sa tlhokomelo ea bophelo bo botle.

english_text: Together we can build healthier and stronger communities.
sesotho_text: Hammoho re ka haha sechaba se phela hantle le se matla.

english_text: Health is wealth — invest in it every single day.
sesotho_text: Bophelo ke leruo — beha chelete ho lona letsatsi le leng le le leng.

english_text: Understanding the difference between a virus and a bacteria helps you know why antibiotics are not always needed.
sesotho_text: Ho utloisisa phapang lipakeng tsa vaerase le baekteria ho thusa ho tseba hore na ke hobaneng li-antibiotic li sa hlokahaleng kamehla.

english_text: Antibiotics should only be taken when prescribed by a doctor.
sesotho_text: Li-antibiotic li lokela ho nkoa feela ha li laetsoe ke ngaka.

english_text: Never demand antibiotics from your doctor if they are not necessary.
sesotho_text: O se ke oa kopa li-antibiotic ngakeng ea hao haeba ha li hlokahaleng.

english_text: Overuse of antibiotics leads to antibiotic resistance.
sesotho_text: Ho sebelisa li-antibiotic ka ho feteletseng ho lebisa ho hana ha li-antibiotic.

english_text: Antibiotic resistance is a serious global health threat.
sesotho_text: Ho hana ha li-antibiotic ke kotsi e matla ea bophelo lefatšeng lohle.

english_text: Complete the full course of antibiotics even if you feel better.
sesotho_text: Phetela khoroso yohle ea li-antibiotic le ha o ikutloa o ntlafetse.

english_text: Painkillers should be used with caution and only as directed.
sesotho_text: Lithethefatsi tsa mahloko li lokela ho sebelisoa ka tlhokomelo le feela joalo ka ha ho laetsoe.

english_text: Over-the-counter medications can have serious side effects if misused.
sesotho_text: Meriana e rekisoang ntle le prescription e ka ba le litlamorao tse matla haeba e sebelisoa hampe.

english_text: Always read the dosage instructions before taking any medication.
sesotho_text: Bala litaelo tsa dose kamehla pele ho nka moriana ofe kafe.

english_text: Do not give adult medications to children without medical advice.
sesotho_text: O se ke oa fa bana meriana ea batho ba baholo ntle le keletso ea bongaka.

english_text: Children require different medication doses based on their weight and age.
sesotho_text: Bana ba hloka li-dose tse fapaneng tsa moriana ho latela boima le lilomo tsa bona.

english_text: Herbal and traditional medicines can interact with prescription medications.
sesotho_text: Meriana ea limela le ea setso e ka kopana le meriana ea prescription.

english_text: Always inform your doctor if you are using any complementary therapies.
sesotho_text: Tsebisa ngaka ea hao kamehla haeba o sebelisa litheraphi tse ling tse tlatseletsang.

english_text: Health screening is recommended even when you feel well.
sesotho_text: Ho hlahloba bophelo bo botle ho khothaletsoa le ha o ikutloa o phela hantle.

english_text: Many serious diseases develop silently without obvious symptoms.
sesotho_text: Mahlwetse a mangata a matla a hola ka khutsiso ntle le matšoao a hlakisehang.

english_text: Blood tests can reveal health problems before symptoms appear.
sesotho_text: Litlhahlobo tsa mali li ka senola mathata a bophelo pele matšoao a hlaha.

english_text: A healthy gut microbiome supports your immune system and overall health.
sesotho_text: Microbiome e ntle ea mala e tshehetsa tšireletso ea 'mele oa hao le bophelo ba hao ka bophara.

english_text: Probiotics found in yoghurt and fermented foods support gut health.
sesotho_text: Li-probiotic tse fumanehang yoghurteng le lijong tse fetohetsoeng li tshehetsa bophelo ba mala.

english_text: Chronic inflammation is linked to many serious diseases including cancer.
sesotho_text: Ho ruruha ha tsoelang pele ho amantsoe le mahlwetse a mangata a matla ho kenyeletsoa kankere.

english_text: Reducing sugar and processed food intake lowers inflammation in the body.
sesotho_text: Ho fokotsa ho nka tsoekere le lijo tse entsoeng ka mokhoa oa indasteri ho fokotsa ho ruruha 'meleng.

english_text: Your lifestyle choices today determine your health outcomes tomorrow.
sesotho_text: Likhetho tsa mokhoa oa hao oa bophelo kajeno li bua ka liphetho tsa bophelo ba hao hosane.

english_text: Taking responsibility for your health leads to a longer and better quality of life.
sesotho_text: Ho nka boikarabello bakeng sa bophelo ba hao ho lebisa bophelong bo telele le bo nang le boleng bo botle.
